from build123d import *

block_length = 80.0
block_width = 60.0
block_height = 20.0
wall_thickness = 1.5
slot_width = 12.0
slot_depth = 8.0
slot_spacing = 20.0
num_slots = 3
fillet_radius = 0.5
chamfer_distance = 0.5

solid_body = Box(block_width, block_height, block_length)
solid_body = offset(solid_body, amount=-wall_thickness)

for i in range(num_slots):
    x = (i - (num_slots - 1) / 2) * slot_spacing
    slot = Pos(x, 0, 0) * Box(slot_width, slot_depth, block_length)
    solid_body = solid_body - slot

solid_body = fillet(solid_body.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z), fillet_radius)
solid_body = chamfer(solid_body.edges(), chamfer_distance)

part = solid_body
part.name = "shelled_block_with_slots"
export_step(part, "output.step")
